name: mdcat-prep
description: MDCAT Prep - offline MDCAT practice app (PM&DC 2025 curriculum)

scripts.build: node build/build.js && mkdir -p www && cp dist/app.html www/index.html
scripts.build:test: MDCAT_TEST_MOCKS=1 node build/build.js && mkdir -p www && cp dist/app.html www/index.html
scripts.build:release: MDCAT_ADS=live node build/build.js && mkdir -p www && cp dist/app.html www/index.html
